Customer: I received a system notice saying 'Service Termination: Account flagged. Immediate cancellation required.' It also claims my account was hacked, but I can still log in fine. My main issue is that I want to stop my subscription renewal immediately because of this threat. Can you cancel my plan?
Agent: We see the error logs. Are you unable to access the game?
Customer: No, access is fine. The notice about termination scares me, so I don't want to renew. Even if the hack claim is fake, please prioritize my request to stop the renewal and downgrade my account.
